title: Vaheb
summary: Raleigh names Vaheb in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Vaheb, the Moabite king whom Sehon conquered, and the predecessor of Balac. VAHEBVM is the Latin accusative in the same sentence. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. VII, sig. 204b–205a
